## About
Antillon Tires is a tire and wheel shop in Phoenix. We carry new and used tires, from entry level options to major brands, plus a wide selection of luxury wheels.
Our wheel alignment is performed with state of the art equipment, and we have payment options available with no credit check. Our goal is quality at affordable prices.
We hold a 4.6 rating from 264 Google reviews. One reviewer came in expecting to replace every tire and was told the rear ones still had tread left on them.

## Services
- New tires: Entry level options as well as major brands, including Goodyear, Michelin, Yokohama, Toyo, Nitto and Continental. ($49.99 & up)
- Used tires: Please contact us for price and availability. ($49.99 & up)
- Alignment: Wheel alignment performed with state of the art equipment. Contact us for a quote.
- Luxury wheels: A wide selection including Fuel, Niche, Foose, KMC, American Racing and factory reproductions. Contact us for pricing and availability.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer payment options?
A: Yes. We have payment options available with no credit check. You can complete our application to get started.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. We're open on Sunday as well as Monday through Saturday.

Q: Do you speak Spanish?
A: A reviewer mentioned getting quick service in both Spanish and English.
